amendment_reason: Records the context windows the corpus is run at and the truncation rule for exhibits that exceed them (ADR 0020). PRECEDES ALL INFERENCE: the first clean-band attempt halted in its first hour on a context defect, its four completed items were discarded, and no forecast has been scored. Head and tail token counts are fixed here so they cannot become a parameter tuned after seeing a result.
note: Pinned so a run crossing midnight cannot silently refetch a new vintage (ADR 0012).

execution.continuation_rule: elapsed time only; no score inspected

failure_reasons.note: A transient failure is left unresolved so the next pass retries it. A terminal failure is recorded as resolved: it would fail identically on every resume, consuming the failure threshold each pass until the run halts on an item that can never succeed.

kv_cache: fp16 (unquantised) — a server-side setting invisible to the cache key, recorded here

truncation.invariant: result is re-estimated and shrunk until it is under budget
truncation.source_hash_semantics: exhibits.by_accession hashes the FULL document EDGAR served; truncation is recorded here, never folded into the hash
truncation.sensitivity_check: primary result reported with and without BXP, FCX and PRU regardless of outcome (ADR 0020, pre-registered)
